newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Moscow airports delay flights due to snowstorms.
newsitem.headline: Moscow airports delay flights due to snowstorms.

text.p: All four Moscow airports had short delays of international and domestic flights on Friday due strong wind and snowstorms, an airport weather centre official said.
"Sheremetyevo, Vnukovo, Domodedovo and Bykovo were closed for 1-2 hours periods during the night and day due to bad weather conditions," the official said.
She said that several airports had problems cleaning snow from their runways. "Snow was very strong and airports' special snow removal machines are working without breaks," the official said.
"Currently, Moscow is in the centre of strong cyclone and weather will be very bad until Saturday afternoon," she said.
